testcase.name: Scenario: Show and hide extended feature names in the browser: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:455:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show and hide extended feature names in the browser ✔ Given a part with a 20 mm new-solid extrusion is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Show Extended Names is unchecked in browser Display Preferences ✔ And the extrusion is displayed with its short feature name ✔ When the user selects Show Extended Names ✔ Then the extrusion's browser label includes its new-solid operation and 20 mm depth ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport ✔ When the user reopens browser Display Preferences ✔ Then Show Extended Names is checked ✔ When the user selects Show Extended Names again ✔ Then the extrusion is displayed with its short feature name ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport
